questions.old_question: Can the harness correlate the AshOban job to operation ID from persisted job args across the pinned AshOban version without relying on transient in-process state?
questions.answer: Distributed admission tests query oban_jobs.args->'primary_key'->>'id' against committed operation IDs and assert cardinality two.
questions.proposed_catalog_edit: Remove job-correlation question; qualify the admission-time query by worker/queue and job-retention window.

questions.old_question: Which audit table/version row should be mandatory for a newly created VM when PaperTrail evolves?
questions.answer: compute_virtual_machines_versions.version_source_id is a VM foreign key and VM has PaperTrail. Admission-specific lifecycle event cardinality is not proved by a current committed-row probe.
questions.proposed_catalog_edit: Replace broad audit question with specific lifecycle-event cardinality question; keep VM version as cross-check, not mandatory atomic core until execution probe.
